products.title: Array F-1 Putter
products.body_html:
A modern mallet engineered for adjustability and total putter customization. Machined to the tightest tolerances for exacting precision, the F-1 features a striking surface forged and machine milled from 1025 carbon steel which is known for its superior sound and softer feel. Choose from multiple hosel, alignment plate, and weight options to build an Array F-1 that is uniquely yours.

  • Interchangeable Hosels: An essential element of getting the ball rolling on the intended target line is returning the putter back to square at impact. Choosing the hosel that best matches your stroke type is crucial. With five different hosels--single bend, slant, short plumber, long plumber, and torque balanced--you can rest assured that there is a hosel optimal for you. (See "Specs" tab, above, for more information.)

  • Six Alignment Plate Options: All golfers have an aim bias. Every line and visible attribute of a putter drives one's eyes to a specific location and dictates where a golfer aims their putter. This creates path deviations and face rotation challenges, among other compensations. Solve your aim bias by pairing your optimal alignment plate with the Array F-1 and sink more putts.

  • Adjustable Weighting: Dial in your speed with different head weights to best match your feel and stroke type. Do you consistently leave your putts short? Try lightening up the head weight to speed up your stroke. For those who often hit it too hard, try a heavier head weight to aid in the slowing of your stroke.

products.body_html:
Our signature non-tapered putter grip, redesigned in a modern dual layer style with embossed logos, durable materials, and updated texture. Free from sharp edges or features that can affect your alignment, it promotes more consistent grip pressure and less face rotation through your stroke. Flat top models accommodate varying grip styles and hand positions.

  • Round Standard: 95 grams, 1.20" diameter.
  • Round Slim: 75 grams, 1.00" diameter.

products.title: EAS 2.0 Putter
products.body_html:
The latest innovation in Torque Balanced Technology is here! Now with more head weight options to optimize your speed control, and interchangeable alignment options to dial in your aim.

Lines on the top help you focus forward and move your aim to the right; while lines on the bottom move your focus backwards and aim more left.

products.title: Pins and Aces Social Golf Tournament - July 17th, 2026
products.body_html:
Come join the fun with the entire Pins & Aces crew!

  • 18 hole 4-man scramble format
  • Friday, July 17th, 2026
  • 8:00am Shotgun Start
  • Location: Willis Case Golf Course
  • Swag bag, food, drinks included — award ceremony and raffles to follow

All tournament entries include a round of golf, breakfast, swag bag, lunch and drink coupons.

Two person entries will be paired with other groups to complete a foursome.

The night before, July 16th we will be having a party at Pins and Aces HQ at 6:00pm! Everyone is welcome to come by for food, drinks, and great deals!

We are also very excited to be partnering with First Tee Colorado on this event! They are an amazing organization that helps kids get into the game of golf while teaching them important life skills and developing them as people!

products.title: Aim Check
products.body_html:
Master Your Aim & Lower Your Score

Think you're aiming straight? Think again.

For years, we've studied aim. What we've learned is that an aiming conundrum is affecting golfers' scores globally. Our research indicates that 97% of golfers can't aim at their intended target. This subtle misalignment can result in missed putts and higher scores, frustrating every golfer. Armed with this knowledge, we've focused our energy on creating products and fitting processes revolving around aim bias.

Stop missing the mark!

Our method for revealing one's aim bias has only been available through certified Edel Golf fittings...UNTIL NOW. Introducing Aim Check! Using Aim Check, golfers can accurately reveal their aim biases and train to correct them.

Have you asked yourself...

  • Where am I aimed?
  • What is my aim bias?
  • Why do I push and pull my putts?
  • How can I make more putts?

...if so, Aim Check is for you!

***Aim Check Laser Backdrop sold separately.*** Train your aim on the go with our laser backdrop! Foldable and featuring a carrying case for ultimate portability, it takes only seconds to setup.
